rules.name: _vocab_parallel_embedding_kernel
rules.role: token embedding lookup
rules.note: SGLang's own embedding kernel; one launch per forward.

rules.name: sglang::fused_a_gemm_kernel<(int)1, (int)2624, (int)6144
rules.role: fused Q and latent KV projection
rules.note: 6144 -> 2624 = q_lora 2048 + kv_lora 512 + qk_rope 64. ReplicatedLinear under TP (deepseek_v2.py), so all four ranks run the identical shape.

rules.name: rmsnormRMSNormKernel_object_at__tensorptrbf16gmemalign16oi642048i64div8
rules.role: RMSNorm over the Q low-rank latent
rules.note: The 2048 in the mangled name is q_lora_rank.

rules.name: rmsnormRMSNormKernel_object_at__tensorptrbf16gmemalign16oi64512i64div8
rules.role: RMSNorm over the KV low-rank latent
rules.note: The 512 in the mangled name is kv_lora_rank.

rules.name: rmsnormRMSNormKernel_object_at__tensorptrbf16gmemalign128oi64204820481
rules.role: RMSNorm over the Q low-rank latent, 128B-aligned instantiation
rules.note: Same 2048 = q_lora_rank as the align16 spelling above.

rules.name: rmsnormRMSNormKernel_object_at__tensorptrbf16gmemalign128oi645125121
rules.role: RMSNorm over the KV low-rank latent, 128B-aligned instantiation
rules.note: Same 512 = kv_lora_rank as the align16 spelling above.

rules.name: flashinfer::RopeQuantizeKernel
rules.role: RoPE on the main query/key, fused with the FP8 KV quantization
rules.note: One launch per layer; the KV-cache dtype is fp8_e4m3, so the quantize half of this kernel is the cache write path, not a separate op.

rules.name: set_mla_kv_buffer_kernel
rules.role: write the latent KV entry into the paged cache
rules.note: Both the plain and the templated sglang:: spelling appear; the fragment matches both.

rules.name: fmhaSm100fKernel_QkvE4m3OBfloat16HQk576HV512
rules.role: DSA sparse MLA
rules.note: HQk576/HV512 is the MLA head geometry and TokenSparse is the DSA mask. SGLang runs ONE kernel for prefill and decode (M1) and picks the variant by seq_lens, so this claims the decode slot and the prefill slot stays empty rather than splitting one measurement across two model ops.

rules.name: fmhaSm100fKernel_QkvBfloat16OBfloat16H256SeparateQkvCausalVarSeq
rules.role: dense ragged MHA prefill
rules.note: M6's step function: below the dense-attn threshold SGLang abandons the sparse path entirely (dsa_backend.py). Bf16 QKV and H256, not the FP8 MLA geometry -- a different kernel family, so a different slot.

rules.name: sglang::fused_q_indexer_rope_hadamard_quant
rules.role: indexer query RoPE, Hadamard transform and FP8 quantization
rules.note: One fused launch. The arch knows it, so it emits no q_quant slot for this kernel to claim (`fused: Glm52DsaFusedLaunches`).

rules.name: sglang::fused_k_indexer_norm_rope_store
rules.role: indexer key norm + RoPE + quantize + cache store
rules.note: Four modelled steps in one kernel (dsa_indexer.py); charged to the cache append because that is the step whose cost scales with the write.

rules.name: deep_gemm::sm100_paged_mqa_logits<
rules.role: indexer MQA scoring against the paged cache
rules.note: The decode-side scorer; `paged` distinguishes it from the ragged prefill scorer below.

rules.name: deep_gemm::sm100_mqa_logits<
rules.role: indexer MQA scoring over the ragged prefill batch
rules.note: SGLang names this kernel after attention.indexer.prefill_logits.

rules.name: topk_transform_prefill_kernel
rules.role: indexer prefill top-k
rules.note: SGLang names this kernel after attention.indexer.prefill_topk.

rules.name: sglang::topk_persistent_cluster_kernel
rules.role: indexer decode top-k (persistent cluster variant)
rules.note: SGLang names this kernel after attention.indexer.decode_topk.

rules.name: sglang::topk_main_kernel
rules.role: indexer decode top-k (main variant)
rules.note: SGLang names this kernel after attention.indexer.decode_topk.

rules.name: sglang::topk_small_batch_kernel
rules.role: indexer decode top-k (small-batch variant)
rules.note: SGLang names this kernel after attention.indexer.decode_topk.

rules.name: sglang::topk_plan
rules.role: indexer top-k plan buffer
rules.note: SGLang names this kernel after attention.indexer.topk_buffer_fill.

rules.name: _get_k_and_s_triton_kernel
rules.role: indexer key/scale gather folded into the fused query RoPE graph
rules.note: The clean SGLang launch graph has no standalone weight_scale leaf: fused_q_indexer_rope_hadamard_quant produces both the FP8 query and scaled weights, so measured companion launches are attributed to that fused rope boundary.

rules.name: sglang::router_gemm_kernel
rules.role: MoE router logits GEMM
rules.note: hidden 6144 -> 256 experts, bf16. The proxy slot name is VibeSim's; the kernel is the router itself.

rules.name: nvfp4_quantizeNVFP4QuantizeLinearKernel_object_at__tensorptrbf16gmemalign16o61446144
rules.role: NVFP4 quantization of the MoE input activations
rules.note: The 6144 in the mangled name is the hidden size, which is what distinguishes this from any other nvfp4_quantize launch.

rules.name: moe::dev::routing::
rules.role: on-device expert routing inside the fused NVFP4 MoE
rules.note: Part of trtllm_fp4_block_scale_moe, not a separate model op: this is where the top-k happens under moe_runner_backend=flashinfer_trtllm, which is why the Python-side expert recorder sees nothing (F16). All routingIndices* variants share this rule.

rules.name: bmm_E2m1_E2m1E2m1_
rules.role: fused NVFP4 MoE grouped GEMM 1 (SwiGLU in the epilogue)
rules.note: trtllm-gen picks a tile per shape, so several t*x*x512 spellings map here; the operation is the same GEMM.

rules.name: bmm_Bfloat16_E2m1E2m1_
rules.role: fused NVFP4 MoE grouped GEMM 2
rules.note: SGLang names this kernel after moe.routed_experts.fused_moe.

rules.name: sglang::moeFinalize
rules.role: weighted top-k expert combine with the shared-expert add folded in
rules.note: `moe_finalize_fuse_shared`, run after the TRT-LLM callable returns unreduced rows (`do_finalize=False`). Its own launch, so its own slot.

rules.name: moe::dev::finalize::finalizeKernel
rules.role: fused NVFP4 MoE finalize (TRT-LLM variant)
rules.note: TRT-LLM's own finalize, inside the callable. It barely runs here -- SGLang defers -- but the few launches that do belong to the callable.

rules.name: sglang::act_and_mul_kernel
rules.role: SwiGLU activation of the shared expert and of the dense FFN
rules.note: GLM-5.2 has 3 dense layers and 75 sparse ones; one kernel serves both.

rules.name: trtllm_allreduce_fusion::allreduce_fusion_kernel
rules.role: fused all-reduce + residual + RMSNorm after the MoE
rules.note: The MoE-side collective, identified by following moeFinalize. M4: SGLang executes it in the NEXT layer's prepare_attn, so its layer attribution is shifted by one -- irrelevant to a per-op total, which is what this comparison is.

rules.name: sglang::all_reduce_kernel
rules.role: vocabulary-parallel embedding all-reduce
rules.note: Immediately after the embedding lookup.

rules.name: ncclDevKernel_AllReduce
rules.role: vocabulary-parallel embedding all-reduce, NCCL path
rules.note: Same position; SGLang picks between its own kernel and NCCL by message size.

rules.name: sglang::all_reduce_kernel
rules.role: non-fused all-reduce after the MoE (the >2048-token fallback)
rules.note: M3's step function: above FUSE_ALLREDUCE_MAX_BATCH_SIZE=2048 the fusion is dropped, and the residual/norm it used to absorb becomes its own FusedAddRMSNorm launch right after.

rules.name: ncclDevKernel_AllReduce
rules.role: non-fused all-reduce after the MoE, NCCL path
rules.note: Same position, NCCL path.

rules.name: sglang::all_reduce_kernel
rules.role: non-fused all-reduce after the MoE (the >2048-token fallback)
rules.note: Folded-body boundaries, read forward: the standalone FusedAddRMSNorm that follows only exists on the non-fused MoE path, so it identifies the collective without the predecessor.

rules.name: ncclDevKernel_AllReduce
rules.role: non-fused all-reduce after the MoE, NCCL path
rules.note: Same position, NCCL path.

rules.name: nvjet_sm100_
rules.role: shared-expert (or dense FFN) down projection
rules.note: The launch immediately after the SwiGLU consumes its output; in this model that is the down projection and nothing else.

rules.name: kernel_cutlass_kernel_TgvGemmCuteExtKernel_
rules.role: shared-expert (or dense FFN) down projection, CUTLASS tile
rules.note: Same position, different backend picked for the shape.

rules.name: nvjet_sm100_
rules.role: shared-expert (or dense FFN) fused gate+up projection
rules.note: The launch feeding the SwiGLU is the gate/up projection.

rules.name: kernel_cutlass_kernel_TgvGemmCuteExtKernel_
rules.role: shared-expert (or dense FFN) fused gate+up projection, CUTLASS tile
rules.note: Same position, different backend picked for the shape.

rules.name: nvjet_sm100_
rules.role: MLA value up-projection
rules.note: The first GEMM consuming the MLA output is the v up-projection; the o projection follows it and is caught by the next rule.

rules.name: kernel_cutlass_kernel_TgvGemmCuteExtKernel_
rules.role: attention output projection, dense-prefill layer
rules.note: The only GEMM after the dense MHA kernel. Charging it to v_up (as the sparse-path rule does) left o_proj unmapped in exactly the iterations the window was chosen to contain.

rules.name: nvjet_sm100_
rules.role: MLA value projection (kv_b_proj), dense-prefill layer
rules.note: The GEMM between the latent-cache write and the dense MHA is `kv_b_proj`, which applies the same `w_vc` the model calls v_up; on this path it runs before the attention instead of after it.

rules.name: trtllm_allreduce_fusion::allreduce_fusion_kernel
rules.role: fused all-reduce + residual + RMSNorm after attention
rules.note: Read forward instead of back: the collective immediately before the MoE router is the attention-side one. `after` cannot express this -- it compares against the IMMEDIATELY preceding kernel, which in these layers is a tile no rule names yet.

rules.name: trtllm_allreduce_fusion::allreduce_fusion_kernel
rules.role: fused all-reduce + residual + RMSNorm after the MoE
rules.note: The collective immediately before the next layer's fused QKV-A projection is the MoE-side one -- M4's shifted attribution stated as a position rather than worked around.

rules.name: trtllm_allreduce_fusion::allreduce_fusion_kernel
rules.role: fused all-reduce + residual + RMSNorm after attention
rules.note: Layers where the router GEMM took the cuBLASLt split-K path instead of SGLang's own router kernel: the collective still sits between the attention output and the router.

rules.name: cublasLt::splitKreduce_kernel
rules.role: shared-expert (or dense FFN) gate+up projection, split-K reduction
rules.note: Same position as the gate/up rules above: the launch feeding the SwiGLU. This is the reduction half of its split-K form.

rules.name: nvjet_sm100_
rules.role: shared-expert (or dense FFN) gate+up projection, split-K GEMM
rules.note: The GEMM half of the pair the previous rule reduces.

rules.name: nvjet_sm100_
rules.role: shared-expert (or dense FFN) gate+up projection, split-K GEMM
rules.note: Same pair, at a repeat-body boundary where there is no preceding kernel to key on (NO_NEIGHBOUR sentinel).

rules.name: cublasLt::splitKreduce_kernel
rules.role: LM head projection split-K reduction
rules.note: The vocabulary projection is the only GEMM whose result is all-gathered across the TP group.

rules.name: flashinfernormkernelsfused_add_rmsnormFusedAddRMSNorm
rules.role: final residual add + RMSNorm before the LM head
rules.note: The last layer's collective is unfused (its residual and norm are not absorbed), so this norm is a launch of its own; the sampler's gather of the last token per request follows it.

rules.name: nvjet_sm100_
rules.role: indexer key weight projection, split-K GEMM
rules.note: The GEMM half of the pair whose reduction the `before_name: sglang::fused_k_indexer_norm_rope` rule already claims -- the two launches are adjacent.

rules.name: nvjet_sm100_
rules.role: LM head projection split-K GEMM
rules.note: The vocabulary projection sits after the sampler's own gather of the last token per request, which is what separates it from every other split-K GEMM in the forward. Keyed on the RMSNorm before it instead, this rule fired on the indexer key projection in EVERY layer and never on the head at all.

rules.name: kernel_cutlass_kernel_TgvGemmCuteExtKernel_
rules.role: Q up-projection from the latent, CUTLASS tile
rules.note: The launch immediately after the q_a RMSNorm, in every layer. The indexer's own wq_b is NOT a candidate here: it sits inside the indexer block, after the key store, and its rule keys on the fused indexer RoPE that follows it.

rules.name: nvjet_sm100_
rules.role: MLA absorb BMM (q_nope @ w_kc)
rules.note: Stated forward instead of back, for the indexer layers where the launch before it is the fused indexer key store rather than the kv_a RMSNorm the other rule keys on.

rules.name: sglang::all_reduce_kernel
rules.role: vocabulary-parallel embedding all-reduce
rules.note: Ordered before the decoder-layer rule for the same kernel name: the embedding's collective is not an attention collective, and without this it would be charged to one.

rules.name: nvjet_sm100_
rules.role: MLA value up-projection, wide-batch layer
rules.note: First of the GEMM pair between the MLA output and the collective.

rules.name: nvjet_sm100_
rules.role: attention output projection
rules.note: The layers where the value up-projection took a tile no rule names, so the MLA kernel is the operation immediately before.

rules.name: nvjet_sm100_
rules.role: Q up-projection from the latent
rules.note: Same position as the CUTLASS-tile rule for this projection.

rules.name: sglang::fused_a_gemm_kernel<(int)1, (int)4096, (int)2048
rules.role: Q up-projection from the latent, min-latency kernel
rules.note: Same position as the two tile rules above. `q_b_proj` is one of the two projections `linear_with_fused_a_gemm` diverts at one to sixteen tokens (`deepseek_v2.py:2236`), so at decode batch this kernel replaces the tile rather than joining it -- 78 launches per decode iteration, one per layer. The indexer's own wq_b has the same (4096, 2048) shape but never reaches that dispatch, which is why this rule must be positional.

rules.name: nvjet_sm100_
rules.role: MLA absorb BMM (q_nope @ w_kc)
rules.note: The last GEMM before the main RoPE. The folded layer body shows TWO GEMMs between the q_a RMSNorm and that RoPE in every layer, not one: the up-projection right after the norm, then this.

rules.name: cublasLt::splitKreduce_kernel
rules.role: MoE router logits GEMM split-K reduction
rules.note: The reduction half of the split-K router GEMM above.

rules.name: kernel_cutlass_kernel_TgvGemmCuteExtKernel_
rules.role: indexer query projection, CUTLASS tile
rules.note: Keyed on the fused RoPE/quant that consumes it, which is what separates this projection from `q_b_proj` -- the two have the same (4096, 2048) shape and share every tile.

rules.name: nvjet_sm100_
rules.role: indexer query projection
rules.note: Same position, different backend picked for the shape.

rules.name: nvjet_sm100_
rules.role: indexer key weight projection
rules.note: The GEMM feeding the fused indexer key norm/RoPE/store.

rules.name: cublasLt::splitKreduce_kernel
rules.role: indexer key weight projection split-K reduction
rules.note: The reduction half of the split-K projection above.

rules.name: trtllm_allreduce_fusion::allreduce_fusion_kernel
rules.role: fused all-reduce + residual + RMSNorm after the MoE
rules.note: The repeat-body boundary, where there is no preceding kernel to key on. The successor separates the two collectives: the MoE-side one opens the next layer with the QKV-A projection (a `tst` tile), the attention-side one is followed by the router GEMM (`tss`).

rules.name: at::native::vectorized_elementwise_kernel
rules.role: indexer key/scale gather folded into the fused query RoPE graph
rules.note: Same fused query-RoPE/weight-scale boundary on the decode side, where the companion launch lands after the scorer.

rules.name: nvjet_sm100_
rules.role: indexer key weight projection, split-K GEMM
rules.note: Wide-batch counterpart of the `after: attention.kv_a_rms_norm` rule: same pair, reached from the fused query-RoPE/weight-scale boundary instead.

rules.name: at::native::vectorized_elementwise_kernel
rules.role: indexer key-cache gather for the ragged prefill scorer
rules.note: Between the indexer cache store and the prefill top-k, which is where the ragged scorer's gather has to be.

rules.name: nvjet_sm100_
rules.role: fused Q and latent KV projection, first layer
rules.note: Layer 0 has no preceding collective to key on -- its input norm is a standalone RMSNorm -- so it is bracketed by the two norms instead: the input norm before it and the q_a norm after.

rules.name: trtllm_allreduce_fusion::allreduce_fusion_kernel
rules.role: fused all-reduce + residual + RMSNorm after attention
rules.note: The attention-side collective: the fused AR is the first one after the sparse MLA in every layer. Pattern kARResidualRMSNorm, so the residual add and the norm are inside this launch and the model's separate add_rms_norm slots have no kernel of their own.

rules.name: nvjet_sm100_
rules.role: attention output projection
rules.note: The last GEMM before the attention-side collective: TP splits o_proj by input, so the all-reduce immediately follows it.

rules.name: kernel_cutlass_kernel_TgvGemmCuteExtKernel_
rules.role: attention output projection, CUTLASS tile
rules.note: Same position, different backend picked for the shape.

rules.name: trtllm_allreduce_fusion::allreduce_fusion_kernel
rules.role: fused all-reduce + residual + RMSNorm after the MoE
rules.note: The shared expert and the routed experts join before the collective; either can be the launch immediately before it.

rules.name: trtllm_allreduce_fusion::allreduce_fusion_kernel
rules.role: fused all-reduce + residual + RMSNorm after attention
rules.note: Layers where the o projection used a tile no rule names yet, so the value up-projection is the operation immediately before.

rules.name: kernel_cutlass_kernel_TgvGemmCuteExtKernel_
rules.role: fused Q and latent KV projection, CUTLASS tile
rules.note: The first GEMM after the MoE-side collective opens the next layer, and it is followed by the q_a RMSNorm -- the two neighbours together leave only the fused QKV-A projection.

rules.name: nvjet_sm100_
rules.role: fused Q and latent KV projection
rules.note: Same position as the CUTLASS-tile rule above, different backend.

rules.name: _all_gather_kernel_inner
rules.role: LM head output all-gather
rules.note: The column-parallel head's output gather. The model has no separate slot for it, so it is charged to the head it belongs to rather than left as unattributed time.

rules.name: nvjet_sm100_tss_
rules.role: MoE router logits GEMM (cuBLASLt split-K path)
rules.note: SGLang's own router_gemm_kernel only covers small batches; wider ones fall to cuBLASLt split-K. Identified by sitting between the attention collective and the MoE input quantization.

rules.name: nvjet_sm100_tss_
rules.role: MoE router logits GEMM, wide-batch tile
rules.note: The GEMM between the attention collective and the MoE input quantization, in the batches wide enough that cuBLASLt picks a single-pass tile instead of the split-K pair.

rules.name: at::native::vectorized_elementwise_kernel
rules.role: indexer key/scale gather folded into the fused query RoPE graph
rules.note: The indexer block opens right after the Q up-projection. In the clean SGLang graph this companion launch belongs to the fused query-RoPE/weight-scale boundary; only index-recompute families declare that slot.
